malobservoj.message: Instance 0 of dialogo holds text in the slot actions, which accepts butono.
malobservoj.suggestion: Put butono in the slot actions.

malobservoj.message: Instance 1 of butono says "Entfernen" (slot:label): it names the verb "entfernen" but not what it acts on.
malobservoj.suggestion: Write the text as the approved example does, e.g. "Projekt löschen".

regulo.name: destructive-label-names-object
regulo.kialo: "Löschen" alone does not say whether the draft, the project or the account goes. Only the object makes the consequence clear before it cannot be undone.

malobservoj.message: 2 instances with emphasis=high in container dialogo-1 (instances 1, 2).
malobservoj.suggestion: Keep one high-emphasis action per container; give the others emphasis=medium or low.

regulo.name: one-primary-per-container
regulo.kialo: Two equal calls to action move the decision onto the user; one primary action makes the next step obvious, and every other action steps back as secondary or tertiary.
